description:
Set up health MONITORING + alerts on a client's box AFTER go-live - the same
    Netdata stack we run for ourselves, on their own server (transparent, no monthly
    fee). Installs Netdata natively, FORCES its dashboard to 127.0.0.1 (never public -
    a hard security rule), writes health alarms (each Odoo systemd unit down, PostgreSQL
    down, nginx down, disk >85%, RAM/swap pressure, sustained high CPU), and wires alert
    delivery. Multi-instance aware: pass `instances=['acme','shop']` (slugs) to also
    alarm on odoo-acme / odoo-shop - omit for just the primary `odoo`.

    Channel: ntfy is the DEFAULT (a phone push independent of the box's own mail - it
    still fires if the server/mail is down). Pass `ntfy_topic` to reuse a topic, or leave
    it blank and one is GENERATED and returned so the client can subscribe at
    https://ntfy.sh/<topic>. Pass `email` instead to deliver by email (needs an MTA on
    the box). dry_run (default) returns the EXACT bash + the alarms file for review;
    confirm=True installs, then self-tests that Netdata answers on 127.0.0.1:19999 and
    the alarms loaded. Idempotent - safe to re-run. NEVER exposes Netdata publicly.
name: monitoring_setup
